## Predictions

- P1a: oWALNUTS defaults trap 3-16 of 480 chains (WP84: 21/300 fits, about 1.75 % of chains; the smoke saw 0 of 120 chains trapped and 1 near-trap that escaped at transition 200) -> observed 8 of 480; held: True
- P1b: CmdStan traps 8-28 of 480 chains (WP84: 39/300 fits, about 3.3 % of chains) -> observed 17 of 480; held: True
- P1c: nutpie traps 0-1 of 480 chains (WP84: 0/300 fits) -> observed 0 of 480; held: True
- P2: mechanism: every trapped oWALNUTS chain has its retained median log_sigma above +0.5 (it never left the high-sigma basin: the smoke's near-trap sat at log_sigma 1.4 with max |gradient| 1e6 and step 1e-6 for 200 transitions), its step is below 0.1 x the median by the end of the initial fast window (collapse window = init) and its first installed metric (transition 99) is the regularisation floor on every coordinate (mass about 6e3); trapped chains start at log_sigma > 0.5 in at least 80 % of cases; the trapped point is more than 1,000 nats below the healthy chains -> observed None of None; held: None
- P3a: nutpie's gradient-scaled initial metric traps 0-1 of 240 chains (nutpie's mechanism is the initial metric, not the start rule) -> observed 1 of 240; held: True
- P3b: TowardUnit regularisation traps at most half the defaults' rate (the floor amplifier removed) but not zero (the chain still crawls at step 1e-6 under the identity metric until transition 100) -> observed 5 of 240; held: None
- P3c: uniform starts trap at least as often per chain as the defaults (CmdStan, which uses uniform starts, trapped more in WP84); normal and median16 within a factor of 2 of the defaults (the start's log_sigma is roughly uniform under best-of-16 in the smoke, so selection is not the driver) -> observed 2 of 240; held: None
- P3d: small_step and stan_search within a factor of 2 of the defaults (the first transition's size is not the driver: the healthy chains of the smoke also started at log_sigma 1.5-1.7); early_windows at least as often as the defaults (an earlier window hits the floor earlier); grad_metric within a factor of 2 (identity until transition 100 either way) -> observed None of None; held: None
- P4: restart, guard-0.01-0 and guard-0.01-1 each remove at least 80 % of the trapped chains (every trapped chain is below ratio 0.01 at transitions 99 and 149); restart fires on at least one earnings cell (WP69 saw 0.031) and the guards on none; no candidate fires on the funnel; guard-0.01-0 fires on at least one healthy A-defaults chain that would have recovered (the smoke's 9989017 chain 2) -> observed None of None; held: None
- P5: R2 holds for every candidate (unfired cells bit-identical, 123/123 in WP69) -> observed None of None; held: None
